edge.note: The outline of all the surveys' supported blocks together; seams between surveys are not edges.

provenance.datum_note: Depths are below each survey's own vertical datum. The original GeoTIFFs declare none; the companion USGS report (Open-File Report 2023-1064) names MLLW. Not converted or certified.
provenance.method: Native cells are merged in the region's binding order (the first survey with valid water wins each cell); each 16 m block is their mean and counts only when all of them are valid water. Marching squares at every 30 ft to 600 ft draws only between four valid blocks of one survey (the survey supplying most of each block), so lines stop where the reviewed grid stops.
provenance.limitations: Not for navigation. Historical survey; the bottom can have changed. Display contours from averaged blocks, not soundings or chart depths.

overview.note: Drawn below max_zoom only; the full contours load at and above it.
